text: Implemented on work/claude-w01: NativeExecutionSafetySuite 'the draft banner follows a native draft, its running job and its completion' pins the banner lead/detail/actions at four moments on a real StudioSession (nothing shown -> draft diff 'grid 40x30 -> 48x32' -> run 2 running with Show disabled -> run 2 finished with Show enabled). Suite 6/6. The diff text is Studio's RecipeChange of the persisted recipe (not the eyes4s plan.diff); acceptable since both describe the same persisted field change.
